3142.title: Unavailable machine providers remain selectable
3142.rootCauseOneLine: The new-thread hook maps the full registered roster into picker options and only queries readiness when no provider preference exists, so machine changes do not remove or replace a remembered not-installed provider.
3142.proposedFix: Join the machine-routed provider readiness result into new-thread option derivation, exclude only confirmed not_installed entries, and recompute the ready fallback whenever routing changes while preserving unknown, authentication, and transient failures.
3142.caveats: The exact remote Linux setup and CLI output were not exercised; the picker and remembered-selection behavior were reproduced twice through the exact React hook with machine-routed provider state.
